author: GoPro
description:
Step inside a firefighter's POV with first responder William Meza. This uncut footage, captured on his GoPro HERO12 Black, puts you on the scene as the crew arrives and works to put out the fire. Filmed in real time, this is what it looks like when a firefighting crew goes to work.

Per @redcross if a fire occurs in your home, get out, stay out + call for help.
